0022600089.text: Both the Utah Jazz and Memphis Grizzlies open their 2026-27 seasons, with Utah on the road, and the Jazz are without Jusuf Nurkic (out with a foot injury). Blake Hinson, Kyle Filipowski and Trey Alexander are day-to-day with hamstring, back and knee issues and are game-time decisions for Utah. Memphis is missing Isaiah Stewart (out with an ankle injury), while GG Jackson (ankle) and Jerami Grant (undisclosed soreness) are day-to-day and game-time decisions, and the teams split their 2025-26 season series 2-2, with Utah winning the most recent meeting 147-101 in Salt Lake City on April 10, 2026. ESPN's matchup predictor gives the Jazz a 55% chance to win.
